Kageaki"..."
Muramasa"...Ah..."
Chachamaru"Good night for a moon-viewing party. But no need to go all the way to Fudaraku."
Chachamaru"Have it here."
黒瀬"Lord of Horigoe!"
Chachamaru"Where is His Highness? Inside?"
Chief"...Lieutenant General, what do you intend! Surrounding Kenchouji with soldiers, knowing it to be His Highness Prince Maidono’s residence—an intolerable outrage!"
Chief"Withdraw at once!"
Chachamaru"Fine standing to say that, Kamakura Chief. What are YOU doing here?"
Chief"..."
Chachamaru"Already exposed, yaar. Raichou spilled it: teaming up with Prince Maidono to take over the shogunate."
Raichou"Wha—"
Chachamaru"Eh? Was that not the story?"
Kageaki"Our stated reason for deploying troops was, I believe, to guard Prince Maidono against an anti-shogunate threat."
Chachamaru"Ah, correct, correct. Sorry, Raichou. Careless mistake."
Raichou"Grr..."
Chachamaru"So, Chief, no need to worry over His Highness."
Chachamaru"Apun came to protect him. From you anti-shogunate fellows!"
Chief"...Ghh..."

署長 「……中将、如何なる存念か！ 　この建朝寺を舞殿宮殿下の御座所と知って 軍兵で囲むなど、許されぬ狼藉！」

署長 「……ッッ……」

Chachamaru dispersed the soldiers around us and stepped forward. The enormous, strangely shaped man beside her also—and Kageaki.

There would be a fight.
Our position was unfavorable—

No.
For me... the reverse.

Nothing had gone as planned, but I had met Kageaki. Then this was an opportunity.

If I restored him with my power, I could change this situation!

ja.html:
兵を周囲に散らして、茶々丸が前へ出てくる。
　隣の異様な巨躯の男も……そして、景明も。

　戦いになる。
　状況はこちらが不利――――

　いや。
　私にとっては……むしろ逆。

　予定とは全く違うけれど、ともかくも景明に会えた
のだ。
　なら、今は好機。

　私の力で景明を元に戻せば、この状況も変えられる！
